## Parties

This Mutual Confidentiality Agreement is entered into by and between Tessel Row Games Oy (the "First Party") and Yarrow Mill Textiles Ltd (the "Second Party"), each referred to individually as a "Party" and together as the "Parties". This Agreement takes effect on 5 March 2026 (the "Effective Date") and is entered into in connection with a shared research project (the "Purpose").

## Confidential Information

"Confidential Information" means any information disclosed by or on behalf of one Party (the "Disclosing Party") to the other Party (the "Receiving Party") in connection with the Purpose, whether disclosed orally, in writing, electronically, visually or by any other means, and whether or not marked as confidential at the time of disclosure. Confidential Information includes, without limitation, research data, methods, protocols, results, samples, designs, specifications, software, technical and commercial information, pricing, customer and supplier details, business plans, and the existence and contents of the discussions between the Parties concerning the Purpose. Confidential Information does not include information that: (a) is or becomes publicly available other than through a breach of this Agreement by the Receiving Party; (b) was lawfully in the Receiving Party's possession, free of any obligation of confidence, before disclosure by the Disclosing Party; (c) is lawfully received from a third party who is free to disclose it; or (d) is independently developed by the Receiving Party without use of or reference to the Confidential Information.

## Obligations

Each Receiving Party shall keep the Disclosing Party's Confidential Information in strict confidence and shall use it solely for the Purpose. The Receiving Party shall not disclose Confidential Information to any third party without the prior written consent of the Disclosing Party, save that disclosure may be made to its directors, officers, employees, researchers and professional advisers who need to know it for the Purpose and who are bound by obligations of confidentiality no less protective than those set out here. The Receiving Party remains responsible for any breach by such persons. The Receiving Party shall apply at least the same degree of care to the Confidential Information as it applies to its own confidential information of like importance, and in no event less than a reasonable degree of care. Disclosure required by law, regulation or court order is permitted, provided the Receiving Party gives prompt written notice where lawful. On written request, the Receiving Party shall return or destroy the Confidential Information in its possession.

## Term

This Agreement commences on the Effective Date and continues for a term of 30 months.

## Governing Law

This Agreement and any dispute arising out of or in connection with it are governed by the law of Scotland.
